summary: 'A Typeface Story in Three Acts': a black-and-gold theatre programme for a serif with optical sizes. A playbill title page opens Acts I–III (Flow & Chisel, Micro to Display, The Epilogue), each split into 'Scenes' of annotated glyph drawings. Between acts, mirrored geometric Lottie 'doors' open on scroll, and two 3D 'building block' walls of Latin inscriptions assemble in perspective while the pointer drives weight or optical size. Page clipped at 30,000px: the Epilogue (2D axis pad, glyph set, CTAs, credits) is read from HTML only.
